claim: The docstring asserts that requests and streamed responses are awaited so a slow model call always yields the event loop, and that a synchronous client here would stall every other request the server handles until it returned.

The client is the SDK's async client. Requests and streamed responses are
    awaited, so a slow model call yields the event loop; a synchronous client
    here would stall every other request the server handles until it returned.
verify_against: the remaining synchronous work on the model-call path in this module and its callers
verify_hint: Trace `send_request`/`stream_request` in `llm.py` for any remaining blocking call (e.g. `_build_payload`, `logger.info` of large payloads, sync token counting) and check whether any caller still invokes a sync Anthropic path
